title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target.
input_format: The first line contains space-separated integers representing the array. The second line contains the target integer.
output_format: Return the two zero-based indices whose values add up to the target.
hints: Try using a hash map to store values you have already seen.
For each number, check whether target - number has already been seen.
Store each number with its index as you scan the array.
editorial: Use a hash map from number to index. For each number x, check whether target - x exists in the map. If it does, return the stored index and the current index. Otherwise, store x and continue.
